news.titleEn: US Military Says It Completed 13th Consecutive Night of Strikes on Iran
news.conclusionEn: The US military completed a 13th straight night of strikes on Iran, targeting military command centers and coastal surveillance sites, while Trump said he is weighing a 'massive attack bigger than anything before' after Tehran rejected a ceasefire proposal.
news.conclusionZh: 美军连续第13晚打击伊朗，特朗普称正考虑发动规模空前的猛烈攻势。
news.whyEn: Nearly two weeks of continuous strikes with no ceasefire in sight keeps oil, gold and shipping markets on edge and raises the risk of a wider regional war.
news.whyZh: 持续近两周的空袭且停火无望，令油价、金价及航运市场持续承压，地区战争风险升高。
news.detailEn: US Central Command said its forces struck Iranian military command centers, drone storage facilities, communication networks and coastal surveillance sites overnight. Iranian state media reported several deaths and said Iran retaliated with drone attacks on US military facilities in Bahrain, Kuwait and Jordan. Iranian and Iraqi officials said Tehran rejected a ceasefire proposal relayed by Iraq's prime minister. Trump told reporters he is considering combat operations 'bigger than anything before,' even as regional mediators continue pushing for a pause in fighting.
news.detailZh: 美国中央司令部表示，其部队连夜打击了伊朗的军事指挥中心、无人机仓储设施、通信网络及海岸监视站。伊朗官方媒体报道有多人死亡，并称伊朗以无人机袭击了美军在巴林、科威特及约旦的军事设施。伊朗与伊拉克官员称，德黑兰拒绝了伊拉克总理转达的停火提议。特朗普对记者表示，正考虑发动"规模空前"的军事行动，与此同时地区斡旋方仍在推动停火。

news.titleEn: Pakistan, Iran Explore Path Towards New Talks With US in a China-Initiated Push
news.conclusionEn: Pakistan and Iran are exploring a path back to US-Iran talks after China initiated a diplomatic push, with Iran's interior minister making his second visit to Islamabad in 10 days.
news.conclusionZh: 在中国推动下，巴基斯坦与伊朗探索恢复美伊谈判的途径。
news.whyEn: China is pressing for a deal because Iran's attacks on Gulf states and threats to the Strait of Hormuz are disrupting trade routes vital to Chinese and global commerce, and any breakthrough could quickly ease oil markets.
news.whyZh: 中国因伊朗袭击海湾国家及威胁霍尔木兹海峡而积极推动斡旋，若取得突破有望迅速缓和油价。
news.detailEn: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi met Pakistani officials in Shanghai to coordinate positions on ending the nearly five-month-old US-Iran war, and Beijing says it supports Pakistan's mediation. A prior US-Iran memorandum of understanding, brokered by Pakistan and Qatar in June, collapsed after indirect talks made no progress. Diplomats say a halt to Iranian attacks on Saudi Arabia and other Gulf nations is now seen as a pre-requisite before any new talks can begin. Oil prices fell on the report as traders weighed the chance of de-escalation.
news.detailZh: 中国外长王毅在上海与巴基斯坦官员会晤，协调结束这场近五个月美伊冲突的立场，北京表示支持巴基斯坦的斡旋努力。此前由巴基斯坦和卡塔尔在6月促成的美伊谅解备忘录，因间接谈判未获进展而破裂。外交人士称，停止对沙特及其他海湾国家的袭击，目前被视为启动新一轮谈判的前提条件。受该消息影响，交易员因缓和预期而推动油价下跌。

news.titleEn: Trump Says Saudi Arabia Must Normalize Israel Ties Before Nuclear Deal Is Approved
news.conclusionEn: Trump said the newly signed US-Saudi civil nuclear agreement is contingent on Saudi Arabia joining the Abraham Accords and normalizing relations with Israel, a condition not disclosed when the deal was announced a day earlier.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普称美沙民用核协议须以沙特与以色列关系正常化为前提。
news.whyEn: Linking a major energy and technology agreement to Middle East normalization could stall the nuclear deal and reshape US strategy in the region, affecting energy companies and defense contractors involved.
news.whyZh: 核协议与中东关系正常化挂钩，可能拖延协议落地并重塑美国中东战略。
news.detailEn: Trump wrote on Truth Social that the deal, which bars uranium enrichment, 'will be approved, but is totally subject to Saudi Arabia joining the very respected and successful Abraham Accords.' The condition surfaced a day after Energy Secretary Chris Wright and his Saudi counterpart signed the agreement without mentioning any such link. Saudi Arabia has long said it won't normalize ties with Israel without a clear path to Palestinian statehood, while Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has dismissed that idea. Critics say the sequencing weakens Washington's leverage to actually secure normalization.
news.detailZh: 特朗普在Truth Social发文称，这份禁止铀浓缩的协议"将获批准，但完全取决于沙特是否加入备受推崇且成功的《亚伯拉罕协议》"。该附加条件是在美国能源部长赖特与沙特同行签署协议一天后才被提出，此前签署时并未提及此类关联。沙特长期表示，在巴勒斯坦建国无明确路径前不会与以色列关系正常化，而以色列总理内塔尼亚胡已否定这一提议。批评者认为，这种先后顺序反而削弱了美国推动沙以关系正常化的实际筹码。

news.titleEn: ICC Member States Vote to Dismiss Chief Prosecutor Karim Khan
news.conclusionEn: International Criminal Court member states voted 82-13 to dismiss chief prosecutor Karim Khan over sexual misconduct allegations he denies, with 15 states abstaining.
news.conclusionZh: 国际刑事法院成员国以82票赞成、13票反对，投票罢免检察官卡里姆·汗。
news.whyEn: The removal of the ICC's top prosecutor, who led high-profile cases including arrest warrants against major world leaders, could reshape the court's pending investigations and its credibility amid claims the vote was politically pressured.
news.whyZh: 国际刑事法院首席检察官被罢免，可能影响多起重大在办案件及法院公信力。
news.detailEn: The closed-door vote took place at UN headquarters in New York, with member states citing findings related to allegations of sexual misconduct involving a female staff member. Khan, 56, denies any wrongdoing, and his lawyers called the process 'illegal, procedurally unfair, and not supported by evidence.' His defenders argue the vote was heavily politicized amid pressure from the Trump administration, which has previously sanctioned ICC officials. The dismissal leaves the court's ongoing investigations, including those tied to the Gaza and Ukraine conflicts, without their lead prosecutor.
news.detailZh: 此次不公开投票在纽约联合国总部举行，成员国援引一名女性工作人员遭受性行为不端指控的调查结果作为依据。现年56岁的汗否认任何不当行为，其律师团队称整个程序"违法、程序不公且缺乏证据支持"。支持他的一方认为，此次投票在特朗普政府此前已对多名国际刑事法院官员实施制裁的背景下，带有浓厚的政治施压色彩。此次罢免使法院包括加沙及乌克兰冲突相关案件在内的多项在办调查，暂时失去首席检察官。

news.titleEn: Volkswagen CFO Addresses Plant Closures, Job Losses as Profits Sink
news.conclusionEn: Volkswagen's operating profit fell nearly 10% to €3.5 billion in the second quarter, missing estimates, as the automaker cut its 2026 sales revenue forecast and considers cutting up to 100,000 jobs.
news.conclusionZh: 大众第二季度营业利润同比下滑近10%，并考虑裁员多达10万人。
news.whyEn: As Europe's largest carmaker, Volkswagen's profit slump and looming mass layoffs signal deeper stress across the German auto industry from Chinese competition and tariff costs, with ripple effects for suppliers and the broader European economy.
news.whyZh: 作为欧洲最大车企，大众利润下滑及大规模裁员预示德国汽车业面临的深层压力。
news.detailEn: Volkswagen posted operating profit of €3.5 billion for the April-to-June period, below the €4.3 billion consensus forecast, with an operating margin of just 4.2% despite revenue rising to €82.4 billion. The company now expects 2026 sales revenue to decline by up to 3%, reversing an earlier forecast for growth of up to 3%. The results follow confirmation that Volkswagen is considering cutting up to 100,000 jobs, twice its previous target, as it contends with billions of euros in tariff costs and intensifying competition from Chinese electric vehicle brands.
news.detailZh: 大众第二季度营业利润为35亿欧元，低于市场预期的43亿欧元，尽管营收升至824亿欧元，但营业利润率仅为4.2%。公司目前预计2026年销售收入将下滑最多3%，一改此前增长最多3%的预测。此前，大众已确认正考虑裁员多达10万人，是此前目标的两倍，原因是公司需应对数十亿欧元的关税成本及来自中国电动车品牌日益激烈的竞争。

news.titleEn: Intel Beats Q2 Estimates With Fastest Revenue Growth in Nearly 15 Years
news.conclusionEn: Intel posted adjusted earnings of 42 cents a share versus 21 cents expected and revenue of $16.1 billion versus $14.42 billion expected, its fastest growth in nearly 15 years, but the stock remains down amid a broader chip-sector selloff.
news.conclusionZh: 英特尔第二季度业绩大幅超预期，创近15年最快营收增速，但股价仍受芯片板块抛售拖累。
news.whyEn: Even a blowout earnings beat failing to lift Intel's stock shows investors are questioning whether AI-driven chip valuations have run too far ahead of demand, a concern hanging over the entire semiconductor sector.
news.whyZh: 业绩大超预期仍未能提振股价，显示投资者担忧AI芯片估值是否已透支未来需求。
news.detailEn: Intel's 25% year-over-year revenue growth was its fastest for any quarter in almost 15 years, yet the stock has fallen roughly 28% in July as part of a broader semiconductor selloff that erased around $3.3 trillion in global chip-stock value. The selloff intensified after Samsung's strong preliminary results still failed to reassure investors about AI infrastructure spending. Analysts say Intel needs more than a single strong quarter to convince markets that its AI and foundry strategy can compete with Nvidia and AMD over the long term.
news.detailZh: 英特尔营收同比增长25%，创下近15年来单季最快增速，但受更广泛的半导体板块抛售影响，其股价7月以来已下跌约28%，此轮抛售已令全球芯片股市值蒸发约3.3万亿美元。三星公布强劲的初步业绩仍未能打消投资者对AI基建支出的疑虑，抛售因此加剧。分析师表示，英特尔仅凭一个季度的强劲表现，尚不足以说服市场其AI与代工战略能在长期与英伟达、AMD抗衡。

news.titleEn: Tesla Posts Record Deliveries But Profit Margins Come Under Pressure
news.conclusionEn: Tesla delivered a record 480,126 vehicles and revenue of $28.24 billion, up 26% year-on-year, but adjusted earnings of $0.33 a share missed the $0.51 estimate as margins narrowed sharply.
news.conclusionZh: 特斯拉交付量创纪录，营收增长26%，但利润率大幅收窄，每股收益不及预期。
news.whyEn: The gap between record sales and shrinking profitability is a key test of whether Tesla can keep growing volume without sacrificing margins, a question weighing on the broader EV sector and the stock fell further after hours on the report.
news.whyZh: 销量创纪录与利润率收窄并存，考验特斯拉能否在扩大销量的同时守住盈利能力，财报后股价盘后进一步下跌。
news.detailEn: Tesla's gross margin slipped to 16.8% from 17.2% a year earlier, well below the 19.4% analysts expected, while operating margin narrowed from 4.1% to just 1.4%. The company cited higher operating expenses, lower regulatory credit revenue and reduced average selling prices for the squeeze, and reported a free cash flow deficit of $1.09 billion versus a surplus in the prior quarter. Shares fell about 1.3% in regular trading and nearly 4% more after hours as investors focused on profitability rather than the delivery record.
news.detailZh: 特斯拉毛利率从去年同期的17.2%降至16.8%，明显低于分析师预期的19.4%，营业利润率则从4.1%大幅收窄至1.4%。公司将利润率承压归因于运营支出上升、监管积分收入减少及平均售价下降，并报告自由现金流出现10.9亿美元缺口，此前一季度尚为盈余。财报公布后，股价在正常交易时段下跌约1.3%，盘后又进一步下跌近4%，显示投资者更关注盈利能力而非交付量纪录。

news.titleEn: Dow Recovers and Sandisk Tumbles 11% as Tech Stocks Fall Further
news.conclusionEn: The Dow rose 0.46% to 51,947 as oil prices retreated 2.25% on de-escalation hopes, while the Nasdaq fell 0.64% as memory-chip maker Sandisk dropped almost 11% and Intel slid 6.5% despite beating earnings.
news.conclusionZh: 道指上涨0.46%，油价回落带动蓝筹股走高，但科技股续跌，闪迪暴跌近11%。
news.whyEn: The split between rising blue-chip and real-estate stocks and falling tech shares shows investors rotating out of richly valued chip and AI names even as broader risk sentiment improves.
news.whyZh: 蓝筹股与地产股上涨、科技股续跌的分化，显示资金正从高估值芯片与AI股票中撤出。
news.detailEn: West Texas Intermediate crude fell to $90.12 a barrel, easing inflation worries and lifting real estate and financial shares, which led gainers on the day. Technology stocks fell 2.37% as a group, with Sandisk down nearly 11% alongside other memory-chip makers and Intel declining 6.5% even after posting a strong earnings beat. Apple bucked the trend, rising 3.5% and helping support the Dow. Gold edged up 0.15% to $4,056.30 an ounce and the 10-year Treasury yield slipped to 4.68%, reflecting still-cautious investor positioning.
news.detailZh: 西德州中质原油跌至每桶90.12美元，缓解了通胀担忧，带动地产与金融股领涨大盘。科技股整体下跌2.37%，闪迪等存储芯片股跌近11%，英特尔尽管财报大幅超预期，股价仍下跌6.5%。苹果逆势上涨3.5%，对道指形成支撑。黄金小幅上涨0.15%至每盎司4056.30美元，10年期美债收益率降至4.68%，反映投资者情绪仍偏谨慎。

news.titleEn: Will the Federal Reserve Raise Interest Rates? Here's What Experts Predict
news.conclusionEn: Economists widely expect the Federal Reserve to hold its benchmark rate at 3.5%-3.75% at its July 28-29 meeting, which would mark a fifth straight meeting without a change.
news.conclusionZh: 经济学家预计美联储7月28-29日会议将连续第五次维持利率不变。
news.whyEn: A hold keeps borrowing costs steady for mortgages, credit cards and business loans, and the decision will shape investor expectations heading into a volatile period marked by Middle East conflict and a chip-sector selloff.
news.whyZh: 维持利率不变将保持借贷成本稳定，并影响投资者对中东冲突和芯片股抛售背景下市场走势的预期。
news.detailEn: The Federal Open Market Committee meets Tuesday and Wednesday, with the rate decision due at 2 p.m. ET on July 29 followed by a press conference from the Fed chair. Economists polled by FactSet see the central bank holding rates steady as it weighs still-elevated inflation risk from tariffs and oil-price swings against a cooling labor market. Because July is not a quarter marked by updated economic projections, no fresh 'dot plot' of rate expectations will accompany the decision, leaving markets to parse the chair's press conference for guidance on the rest of 2026.
news.detailZh: 联邦公开市场委员会将于周二、周三举行会议，利率决议将于美东时间7月29日下午2时公布，随后美联储主席将召开记者会。FactSet调查的经济学家普遍预计，央行将在权衡关税及油价波动带来的通胀风险与降温中的就业市场之间，选择维持利率不变。由于7月并非公布经济预测摘要的会议，此次决议不会附带更新的"利率点阵图"，市场只能从记者会中揣摩美联储对2026年下半年利率路径的态度。

businessTips.explanationEn: The sunk cost fallacy is the tendency to keep investing time, money or effort into a decision because of what's already been spent, rather than because the decision still makes sense going forward. Sunk costs are gone regardless of future choices, so rational decisions should only weigh future costs and benefits. Falling into this trap often leads managers to prop up failing projects rather than cut losses.
businessTips.explanationZh: 沉没成本谬误是指人们因为已经投入的时间、金钱或精力，而继续投入某项决策，而不是基于该决策未来是否仍然合理来判断。沉没成本无论未来如何选择都已无法收回，因此理性决策应只权衡未来的成本与收益。陷入这一误区常导致管理者硬撑失败的项目，而不是及时止损。
businessTips.exampleEn: A company has spent $2 million building a software product that customers show little interest in. Rather than admitting the loss, leadership approves another $500,000 to 'finish what they started' — even though a clear-eyed look shows the money would be better spent elsewhere.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家公司已投入200万美元开发一款客户反响冷淡的软件产品。管理层没有承认损失，反而批准再投入50万美元"善始善终"——尽管客观分析显示，这笔钱用在别处会更有价值。

businessTips.explanationEn: Bootstrapping means building and growing a business using personal savings and early revenue rather than raising outside investment. It forces founders to reach profitability quickly and keeps them in full control of the company, but it also limits how fast they can scale compared to venture-backed rivals. Many successful companies started this way before later raising capital, if they raised it at all.
businessTips.explanationZh: 自筹资金（Bootstrapping）是指创业者依靠个人积蓄和早期营收来创办和发展企业，而不是依赖外部融资。这迫使创始人尽快实现盈利，并让他们保持对公司的完全掌控权，但相较于获得风投支持的竞争对手，扩张速度也会受限。许多成功企业最初都是这样起步的，有些后来才融资，有些则始终未融资。
businessTips.exampleEn: A freelance designer starts a side business selling templates online, reinvesting every dollar of profit into ads and new products instead of seeking a loan or investor. After a year of slow, self-funded growth, the side business replaces her full-time income without her ever giving up equity.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位自由设计师开始在网上销售设计模板作为副业，把每一分利润都重新投入广告和新产品开发，而不是寻求贷款或投资人。经过一年缓慢的自筹资金式增长，这份副业收入最终超过了她的全职工资，而她始终没有出让任何股权。

businessTips.explanationEn: Dollar-cost averaging is an investment strategy of putting a fixed amount of money into an asset at regular intervals, regardless of its price, rather than trying to time the market with a single lump sum. It smooths out the average purchase price over time, reducing the risk of investing everything right before a downturn. The tradeoff is that it can underperform a lump-sum investment during a steadily rising market.
businessTips.explanationZh: 定投（美元成本平均法）是一种投资策略，即不论资产价格高低，定期投入固定金额，而不是试图一次性择时买入。这种方法能拉平一段时间内的平均买入成本，降低在下跌前一次性全仓买入的风险。其代价是，在持续上涨的市场中，定投的收益可能不如一次性投入。
businessTips.exampleEn: With markets swinging on Middle East conflict headlines and chip-stock selloffs this month, an investor sticks to putting $500 into an index fund on the same day every month rather than trying to guess the bottom, buying more shares when prices dip and fewer when prices are high.
businessTips.exampleZh: 本月市场因中东冲突局势和芯片股抛售剧烈波动，一位投资者仍坚持每月固定日期投入500美元买入指数基金，而不是试图猜测市场底部——价格下跌时买入更多份额，价格较高时买入较少份额。
